newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Universal Bank H1 pre-tax gains up 91 pct.
newsitem.headline: Universal Bank H1 pre-tax gains up 91 pct.

text.p: (In thousands of Cyprus pounds excluding per share)

NOTE - Full company name is Universal Savings Bank. The results do not include any provision for writing off debts based on an amendment to the Relief of Debtors Law (temporary regulations) of 1979 to 1995 which came into effect on April 26 1996.
Under this law, all debts of displaced persons to an authorised financial institution should be written off because they are not considered collectable.
Consequently, the bank said in a statement, a sum of up to 992,444 pounds comprised of loans and subsidies issued by the bank before August 15, 1974 will possibly have to be written off.
